alignments.note: Inflected verb takes its English subject pronoun as a rule 7/9 helper, headed on the lexical verb *Know*. The supplied complementizer *that* is not here: rule 85 places it on the non-finite complement (the participle), not on the governing finite verb.
Rule 20 proper: the genitive pronoun ἡμῶν is free and takes the English possessive *our*, so the article governing ἀδελφόν realizes nothing.
Bare noun; its determiner slot is occupied by the possessive on s004.
Genitive pronoun rendered by the possessive *our* under rule 20.
Name split from ἀδελφόν as an independently recoverable correspondence under rule 26.

Accusative-participle complement expanded into a finite clause: the supplied complementizer *that* belongs to the participle under rule 85, and the auxiliaries *hath been* ride along under rules 7 and 9. Head on *liberty* under rules 17 and 91: *set at liberty* is a set+complement frame whose complement carries the lexeme (cf. `set` frames headed on the complement at GAL.5.1, 1PE.1.13), and *set* is the empty support word. Heading on *set* remains defensible if the frame is read as an ordinary passive verb phrase.
Preposition realized by the English preposition governing the relative under rule 36.
Relative pronoun on its own English word under rule 2.
Ordinary conditional ἐάν, aligned to *if* — rule 72's generalizing arm is not in question, no relative-plus-particle compression standing here.
Comparative adverb rendered by the single adverb *shortly*.
Subjunctive with its English subject pronoun as a rule 9 helper, headed on the lexical verb *come*.
Future indicative with supplied subject and future auxiliary as rule 9 helpers, headed on the lexical verb *see*.
Accusative object pronoun on its own English word.

review_notes: Every s### and t### id is partitioned exactly once: 13 source, 21 target.
s002 is the only unrepresented unit; rule 20 proper applies because ἡμῶν is free and carries *our* itself.
*that* (t003) is placed on the participle s006 per rule 85 rather than on the finite γινώσκετε; JHN.5.39's contrary placement is the hedged dissent rule 85 names.
Head of s006 taken on *liberty* per rules 17 and 91's set+complement precedent; the competing head on *set* is named in the unit's note.
